$comment-1: How to adapt: .mcp.json is the agent's tool registry. It tells the agent which external servers it can call during a session — your docs, your design system, your search index, your linter. Keep it short. Every entry should pull its weight. If you're not sure whether to add a server, leave it out; clutter here is worse than a missing tool.
$comment-2: FieldKit example below: Uno docs MCP (always on for Uno work), Microsoft Learn docs (for .NET / WinUI reference), and a placeholder for a project-internal docs server. Replace or extend.

uno-platform-docs.$description: Official Uno Platform docs, searchable + fetchable. Use for API patterns, control reference, troubleshooting, and the rule-init endpoints that gate-load Uno conventions.

microsoft-learn.$description: Microsoft Learn search + fetch for .NET, C#, WinUI, and Azure docs.

internal-docs.$description: Placeholder for your project's internal docs server (Confluence, Notion, GitBook, or a local Markdown index). Delete if you don't have one.
